description: Get the posterly subscription: status, tier, cancel-at-period-end, period end, trial end, pause state, connected accounts in use and the account limit for this workspace (tier plus extra slots). Call FIRST for "upgrade", "change plan", "add accounts" or "how many accounts": it returns the plans above this one with prices, limits and credits, the Agency extra-accounts state (owners) and next steps. On a trial, limits stay until the paid plan starts: see manage_plan. Read-only. Requires the billing:read scope.
name: get_subscription
